title: US Newspapers Fell 39%, Creating More Local News Deserts
hook: US newspapers fell 39%, leaving more towns without watchdogs.
closing: When local reporting disappears, fewer people watch decisions that shape your town.
question: Do you know your local reporter?

segments.say: US newspapers fell 39%, stripping thousands of communities of regular local reporting.
News deserts reached 208 counties, leaving every resident without a dedicated local source.
Little or no local news affects 15% of Americans, linking newspaper collapse directly to what communities know.
